svg.title: OrbCue — github.com/QZYH123/OrbCue
svg.desc: Project pane for OrbCue: a desktop orb for Windows that cues you when Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Agent, Grok and other terminal AI agents need you. Built with Rust, Tauri 2 and Svelte 5. Left: a real screenshot of the orb showing 0/3 with a ? waiting badge.
svg.text: A desktop orb for Windows that cues you when your
terminal AI agent needs you. Local-only, hook-based.
一颗放在 Windows 桌面上的小球，替你盯着终端里的 AI 助手：
它们在忙时安静计数，轮到你时才出声。
